
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhuweisky/p/20988703" title="发布于 2026-07-01 09:49">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">视频会议是如何实现AI会议纪要功能的？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        对于视频会议软件而言，会议纪要功能现在几乎成了标配，为会议结束后回顾会议内容提供了极大的方便，省去了大量的人力。接下来我们以傲瑞会议（OrayMeeting）为例，来介绍会议纪要功能的具体实现。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">　　对于视频会议软件而言，会议纪要功能现在几乎成了标配，为会议结束后回顾会议内容提供了极大的方便，省去了大量的人力。接下来我们以&nbsp;<a href="https://www.oraytalk.com/prov.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">傲瑞会议</a>（OrayMeeting）为例，来介绍会议纪要功能的具体实现。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">　　傲瑞会议纪要功能基于会议实时音视频数据流，实时采集会议语音音频。借助AI能力完成语音实时转写、语义规整与核心信息提炼，自动生成标准化的会议纪要。 并且客户端可实现全文内容与重点摘要分层渲染展示，全面满足会议全流程智能化纪要生成及归档管理的业务需求。 傲瑞视频会议的纪要功能的效果如下图所示：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/9005/202607/9005-20260701093222803-881236104.png" alt="jiyao01" width="747" height="424" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>一、功能说明&nbsp;　　</h2>
<div>（1）主持人创建会议时，可勾选控制是否开启会议纪要。</div>
<div>（2）如果创建时没有开启纪要，也可以在会议进行过程中通过设置菜单手动开启。</div>
<div>（3）纪要功能开启后，服务端实时采集参会人发言音频，通过ASR语音转写与智能纪要接口自动整理成文，并实时推送至所有参会人员。</div>
<div>（4）参会者可实时查看动态更新的纪要内容，会议纪要完成后还能一键复制导出完整纪要内容，方便留存查阅。</div>
<h2>二、实现原理</h2>
<div>　　要实现会议纪要功能，有两个地方需要用到AI功能。</div>
<div>（1）实时语音转文字（ASR）。</div>
<div>（2）会议摘要生成。</div>
<div>　　傲瑞会议支持两种方式接入AI功能：</div>
<div>（1）利用大厂发布的AI服务（如讯飞在公网提供的服务接口）。</div>
<div>（2）私有部署本地大模型（如FunASR、QWen）。</div>
<div>　　接入的两种AI能力，通过统一的接口规范起来，在部署的时候可以自由选择配置。</div>
<h2>三、服务端实现</h2>
<div>
<h3>（1）AI 能力对接<span style="font-size: 14px">&nbsp;</span></h3>
</div>
<div>　　服务端实时拉取会议音频码流，同步转发至 AI 语音转写模型，实现语音到文本的实时转换；经由 AI 大模型完成语句规整、冗余语气词过滤、内容梳理归纳及会议重点萃取。</div>
<div>　　首先是语音识别接口IASRWebApi，其定义如下：</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 语音识别WebApi调用接口
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IASRWebApi
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 每返回一段有效识别文本时触发
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span> Action&lt;VoiceDictationModel&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AudioConvertSucceeded;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化ASR识别会话
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="index"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">会话索引</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="speakerID"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">说话人</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="startTime"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">本次语音片段采集起始时间</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Init(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> index, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> speakerID, DateTime startTime);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单次完整说话结束调用，告知ASR引擎做断句、完整识别输出
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="endTime"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">语音采集结束时间</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="isEnd"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">是否为整轮会话完全结束；true=关闭连接销毁会话，false=仅单句停顿结束</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> AudioEndNotify(DateTime endTime, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> isEnd = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 异步入队一段PCM音频分片数据，推送到ASR WebApi进行流式识别
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="pcmData"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">PCM音频</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="_status"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">音频的发送状态;0：第一帧；1：继续帧；2：最后一帧  等</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    Task EnqueueAudioChunk(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] pcmData, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> _status = -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div>　　会议纪要接口IMeetingSumWebApi，其定义如下：</div>
<div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 会议纪要生成WebApi调用接口
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IMeetingSumWebApi
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发起会议纪要/摘要生成请求
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="speechModels"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">语音识别结果集合</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="isCompleteContent"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">true生成完整正式纪要，false为实时片段摘要</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一个bool：true=接口调用正常，第二个string=生成的会议摘要/完整纪要文案；失败时返回错误描述
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
    Task&lt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>)&gt; Ask(List&lt;VoiceDictationModel&gt; speechModels, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> isCompleteContent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　接下来我们给出&nbsp;IMeetingSumWebApi 接口的讯飞版（调用讯飞的API）实现：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用 AI 会议纪要生成接口
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>  
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>)&gt; Ask(List&lt;VoiceDictationModel&gt; speechModels, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> isCompleteContent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    CancellationToken token </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CancellationToken();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> resultStr = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Empty;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> domain = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">generalv3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        _webSocketClient </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClientWebSocket();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> _webSocketClient.ConnectAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(authUrl), token);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> speechTexts = speechModels.Select(s =&gt; $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{s.SpeakerID}：{s.ConvertText}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> allContent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Join(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, speechTexts); 
        List</span>&lt;ReuqestContent&gt; reuqestContents = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;ReuqestContent&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReuqestContent()
            {
                Role </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                Content </span>= isCompleteContent ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt1 : prompt2
            },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReuqestContent()
            {
                Role </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                Content </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> allContent
            }
        }; 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> request = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonRequest()
        {
            Header </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RequestHeader()
            {
                AppId </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _appId,
                Uid </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">12345</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            },
            Parameter </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RequestParameter()
            {
                Chat </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RequestChat()
                {
                    Domain </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> domain,
                    Temperature </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                    MaxTokens </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1024</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                }
            },
            Payload </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RequestPayload()
            {
                Message </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RequestMessage()
                {
                    Text </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> reuqestContents
                }
            }
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> jsonStr =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(request);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> _webSocketClient.SendAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArraySegment&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt;(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jsonStr)), WebSocketMessageType.Text, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, token); 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> recvBuffer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1024</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            WebSocketReceiveResult result </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> _webSocketClient.ReceiveAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArraySegment&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(recvBuffer), token);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (result.CloseStatus.HasValue)
            { 
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result.MessageType ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebSocketMessageType.Text)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> recvMsg = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(recvBuffer, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, result.Count);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response = Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.DeserializeObject&lt;JsonResponse&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(recvMsg);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (response.Header.Code != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                { 
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, response.Header.Message);
                } 
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (response.Payload.Choices.Status == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                {
                    resultStr </span>+= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Concat(response.Payload.Choices.Text.Select(x =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.Content)); 
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, resultStr);
                }
                resultStr </span>+= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Concat(response.Payload.Choices.Text.Select(x =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.Content)); 
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result.MessageType ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebSocketMessageType.Close)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, result.CloseStatusDescription);
            }
        }
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e.Message);
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> _webSocketClient?.CloseAsync( WebSocketCloseStatus.NormalClosure,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">client raise close request</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,token);
    }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 实时获取会议音频数据，混音分贝值排名第一的用户
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> MicMixer_AudioMixed(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> userID, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] bytes)
{ 
    AudioMixed</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Invoke(userID, bytes); 
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对接语音听写服务接口

<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="curStatus"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">0：首次发送；1：发送中；2：结束发送</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="data"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">音频数据</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> onSend(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> curStatus, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (curStatus == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> json = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            common </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                app_id </span>= $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{_appID}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            },
            business </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                language </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zh_cn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                domain </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">iat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                accent </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mandarin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                eos </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            },
            data </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                status </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                format </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">audio/L16;rate=16000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                encoding </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">raw</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                audio </span>= $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{data}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            }
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> jsonStr =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonConvert.SerializeObject(json, Formatting.Indented);
        _ws.SendAsync(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArraySegment&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>&gt;(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jsonStr)), WebSocketMessageType.Binary, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CancellationToken());
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (curStatus == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    { 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> json = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            data </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                status </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                format </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">audio/L16;rate=16000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                encoding </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">raw</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (curStatus == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    { 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> json = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</div>
<h3><span style="font-size: 1.17em">（2）记录存储</span></h3>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;　　将语音实时转写文本、AI 完整会议纪要、会议重点摘要及相关元数据封装为统一数据对象，以 JSON 格式序列化后写入 TXT 文件进行本地持久化保存。统一文件命名与存储目录规范，便于后续纪要查阅、内容复用与历史记录检索，保障会议全量资料完整留存、可追溯可复用。</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Save()
   {
       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
       {
           </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> data = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
           ESBasic.Helpers.FileHelper.GenerateFile(MeetingCacheFilePath, data);
       }
       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ee)
       {
           Program.Logger.Log(ee, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MeetingMinutesCache.Save</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ErrorLevel.Standard);
       }
   }</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h2>四、通信消息交互</h2>
<div>&nbsp;　　傲瑞会议采用 <a href="https://www.oraycn.com/ESFramework_detail.aspx" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">ESFramework </a>完成客户端与服务端的实时通信，统一制定与会议纪要相关的业务消息协议。定义会议起始、AI 纪要分段下发、纪要生成完成等标准消息指令。依托标准协议标识规整消息交互逻辑，依托协议编号区分不同业务数据流，便于后续交互流程核查、问题定位与功能迭代，保障通信交互规范可追溯、易维护。</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开启会议纪要
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> CloseMeetingMinutes { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">666</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>

</div>
<h2>五、客户端&nbsp;</h2>
<h3>（1）UI 控制&nbsp;</h3>
<div>　　会议主界面预留会议纪要功能独立入口，支持手动启停纪要服务。同时提供纪要面板展开 / 收起、内容复制等常用操作入口，界面布局简洁易用，操作逻辑直观便捷。</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202605/20404-20260514145758317-1668702488.png" alt="image" width="969" height="548" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<h3>（2）纪要内容渲染&nbsp;</h3>
<div>　　基于 ESFramework 内置 <code>IChatRender</code>&nbsp;消息渲染组件，可快速实现类似腾讯会议的纪要消息排版展示效果。客户端监听服务端实时推送的分段纪要数据，采用增量拼接、动态渲染机制，完成内容实时刷新。对完整纪要、AI 重点摘要、发言人信息、时间节点等重要信息进行清晰的展示。&nbsp;</div>
<div>　　</div>
<div>　　以上就是&nbsp;<a href="https://www.oraytalk.com/prov.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">傲瑞视频会议</a>&nbsp;借助AI来实现会议纪要功能的基本原理和方案，有什么疑问或建议的，欢迎留言讨论交流，谢谢！</div>
